name: Varka
title: Knight of Boreas
description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

skills.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Windbound Execution
skills.description:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and switching to Sturm und Drang mode.
While in Sturm und Drang, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in Sturm und Drang, if there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension to perform a special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG.

Hold
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.

attributes.label: Sturm und Drang Charged Attack DMG

skills.name: Northwind Avatar
skills.description:
In the name of the mightiest Knight of Boreas, unleash a powerful double slash attack toward the front, dealing 2 instances of Anemo DMG.
If there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.

passives.name: Dawn Wind's March
passives.description:
When there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% Anemo DMG Bonus and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way.

Additionally, if there are at least 2 Anemo characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack Azure Devour and the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension that Varka deals or unleashes while in the Sturm und Drang mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 Anemo characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.

passives.name: Wind's Vanguard
passives.description: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack Azure Devour and special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath every second this way.

passives.name: Homebound Wind's Paean
passives.description:
For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution's CD is decreased by 5%.
This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"
constellations.description:
When Varka switches to Sturm und Drang, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension.
Additionally, after switching to Sturm und Drang, Varka will gain the Lyrical Libation effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by Four Winds' Ascension or Azure Devour.

constellations.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"
constellations.description: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing AoE Anemo DMG equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.

constellations.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Skill Windbound Execution Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
constellations.description: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% Anemo DMG Bonus and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.

constellations.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"
constellations.description:
Increases Elemental Burst Northwind Avatar Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"
constellations.description:
Sturm und Drang is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, Azure Devour.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of Four Winds' Ascension without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the Azure Fang's Oath effect in Ascension Talent Wind's Vanguard is enhanced: Every stack of Azure Fang's Oath will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.

outfits.name: Oath to the North Wind
outfits.description: Varka's outfit. A knight's conviction is more steadfast than any armor, and Boreas's resolve is sharper than the keenest blade. To don this suit of iron and speak this oath — it seems but yesterday, yet the years have flown by.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Allow me to introduce myself again, though you're probably bored of hearing it by now. I am Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, Mondstadt's Knight of Boreas. I'm here to fulfill the Favonian pledge: I swear by my sword, you shall not fall while I stand.

voices.title: Chat: Drinking
voices.text: I like to drink on occasion... any and every occasion. Ha! Haha, good one.

voices.title: Chat: Weapons
voices.text: Weapons need regular maintenance. Take good care of them, and they'll take care of you when it matters most.

voices.title: Chat: Rest
voices.text: *sigh* Sure feels good to get away from my desk. Now, where's a good spot for a nap?

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: The rain's stopped. We march on.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Seeing the snow fall always reminds me of places I've been through on past expeditions...

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: Whoa, that's a strong wind! Trying to knock me down, huh?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning! ...Huh, you're looking pretty groggy. How about a drink to perk you up?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Afternoon! We got some down time. Make sure to get some rest, or your afternoon's gonna be a real grind.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Evening! Long day, huh? How 'bout a nightcap to help you sleep?

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Night. Even the wind needs to rest sometimes. I'll keep watch outside the tent. ...Don't need a night watch? Oh.... right, yeah — we're not sleeping rough. Hah, old habits...

voices.title: About Varka: Knight of Boreas
voices.text: The Knight of Boreas serves as a bridge between humans and Lupus Boreas. But only a handful of us have truly managed to earn the wolf lord's recognition over the past millennium... Me? Hahaha, oh yeah. You'd better believe I'm one of them.

voices.title: About Varka: The Expedition
voices.text: I've been on many expeditions to keep the peace around Mondstadt, although none of them hold a candle to this one... One time, we cleared out Dadaupa Gorge. Another, we joined forces with the Millelith to pacify Stone Gate. And once, we set out from Falcon Coast to intercept some sea monsters offshore... Hmm? No wonder you've never run into any strong foes in those areas? ...Really? I was sure I left a few here and there for people to practice on...

voices.title: About Us: Outlander
voices.text: Mondstadt is the city of freedom. It's a place that anyone can call home — whether you're the child of a sinner, a wandering god, or a traveler from afar. So, no need to stand on ceremony with me — you're the Honorary Knight, after all!

voices.title: About Us: Catching the Wind
voices.text:
"Focus on a single thought within the thousand winds, capture that unique wisp before it blows away."
That's what Barbatos said to me when he explained how to reverse the assimilation process. Unless you separate yourself out from Lupus Boreas, there's no way to avoid merging with the Ley Lines... I didn't understand his words at the time, but after experiencing it firsthand... Nope, I still don't really get it, haha! At least I won't have to go through that again.
Come to think of it, I still haven't properly thanked you since I returned from the Ley Lines. Well, now's as good a time as any. Ahem...
You caught me, "Outlander Who Caught the Wind."

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: I remember the day I got my Vision well. I was still a reckless young hothead back then. Boy, was I thrilled that the Anemo Archon had noticed me... Until I actually got to know Barbatos for myself, and realized that wasn't what it meant at all. Another youthful dream shattered! But the power it gave me, and the aspirations that brought it my way... those will never change.

voices.title: Something to Share: The Four Winds
voices.text: You know, I've never really understood the logic behind "The Four Winds." I mean, the Dragon of the East, Falcon of the West, Lion of the South — they're pretty clear cut, right? But "Wolf of the North" could refer to either Boreas or me. And the "Knights of Favonius" includes both the Lionfang Knight and the Knight of Boreas, which means the Favonian "West Wind" actually includes both the "South" and the "North." How does that make any sense?\nHmm? You think some bard picked the number four to make it sound cool? ...Yeah, actually, that tracks...

voices.title: Interesting Things: Cats and Dogs
voices.text: Mondstadt once had a debate between "cat people" and "dog people." You'd think the Knight of Boreas should probably lean towards dogs, right? But truth be told, I've kinda got a soft spot for cats too, you know? Puppies are real cute with their energy and all, but a nice, quiet cat also makes a great companion, too. Ah... If I had the chance to adopt... Yeah, I'd have to take 'em all!

voices.title: About Venti
voices.text: Barbatos? He may seem carefree and easy-breezy at first glance, but when things get serious, so does he. And I've gotta give him credit, the man's got taste when it comes to drinking — truly a god worthy of Mondstadt! ...Hmm? Sounds like I'm talking about myself...? Hahahaha, you flatter me! I'm nothing next to the Anemo Archon himself!

voices.title: About Razor
voices.text: Back when I first met Razor, he was only a few inches taller than the wolf pups of Wolvendom. Heh, he could barely lift a greatsword! But even then, teaching him how to use it was easier than learning how to talk with him. Must've taken me at least half a year to get the hang of it. All these years later, and he's made so many friends of his own... How time flies.

voices.title: About Rosaria
voices.text: Uh... I'll keep my lips sealed where she's concerned. Don't wanna get scolded for being a blabbermouth. There's ice in that glare of hers... If there's anything you wanna know, you're better off asking her yourself. I think that by now... she should be ready to talk about the past with you.

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: So, he still won't return to the Knights? Haha, fair enough — the wind in Mondstadt has always been free to come and go as it pleases. He has the freedom to not come back, and by the same token, I have the freedom to keep pestering him to rejoin. Still, I probably shouldn't push my luck... If I nag him too much, he could put me on Dawn Winery's blacklist. Now that would be a real crisis!

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: I know how much Master Crepus meant to Kaeya. That tragic incident was no less devastating for him than for his adoptive brother. But even after enduring such injustice and fraternal strife... he still chose to remain with the Knights. Ended up playing a key role in exposing Eroch's corruption, too. Since he chose to trust us, I also choose to trust him, no matter what lies in his past.

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Y'know, I've always felt that Jean's got the talent and temperament to be a way better Grand Master than I am. But no matter how hard I try to convince her, she always insists that she's not qualified enough. Heh, her and me both! I was pretty young myself when I took up the mantle. Honorary Knight, if you get the chance, could you try talking her round... Hmm? You think I'm trying to dump all my work onto Jean? Absolutely not, perish the thought, I would never! Really! ...Swear on a glass of wine? Uh, there's no need for that, is there...?

voices.title: About Noelle
voices.text: Even I was surprised by her innate strength. I heard she's learning the sword from Jean now. After she's mastered both single- and two-handed sword styles, I wonder if she might be able to inherit my... Huh? She chucked her sword straight up into the ceiling last time? Alright then... Guess we need to schedule a few more training sessions for her.

voices.title: About Lohen
voices.text: Feels like every other day that that rascal's causing some kind of ruckus... I used to think he was like a younger me — eager to fight strong foes and win glory... Turns out, he's just into the fighting part, couldn't care less about the glory. *sigh* Well, at least when he's fighting the enemy, it keeps him busy. Otherwise, he'll be digging traps to ambush me out of boredom.

voices.title: About Mika
voices.text: When you're lost in life, you need a mentor to guide you, and when you're lost on a march, you need a map. By that logic, you could say Mika's my mentor, haha! ...I tried telling that joke to Mika, but uh, he went pale as a sheet... Honestly, he should have more confidence in himself. After all, not everyone could be a knight!

voices.title: About Eula
voices.text: I'd been planning to send someone to Dornman Port to receive the troops, but Eula told me she had already arranged it. I reviewed the schedule, and everything was handled perfectly. I hadn't expected her to be so thorough, and this time she never mentioned vengeance even once. Haha, nothing makes me happier than seeing our knights grow.

voices.title: About Amber
voices.text: She's a ball of energy, isn't she? As our Outrider and Gliding Champion, she's usually active around the outskirts of Mondstadt, helping those in need. She's the first Knight of Favonius most visitors will meet, meaning she's practically the public face of the organization. Hmm? She was the first Knight you met, too? Haha, that's our Amber!

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: When Albedo first arrived in Mondstadt, he struck me as one of those model kids that all parents wish their own children were more like. So modest, so well-mannered... But to put it another way, he seemed quite reserved and cautious. I was hoping he'd learn to loosen up a bit. After all, how can you call yourself the City of Freedom if people aren't comfortable just being themselves? Well, I may have gotten more than I bargained for, 'cause these days he'll even rib me about my painting skills! Hahahaha!

voices.title: About Durin
voices.text: I'm not gonna lie, when I first got reports about Durin's resurgence, my heart skipped a beat. I was about to send a crack team back home to defend Mondstadt... Thankfully, the new Durin is nothing like the old Durin, and what was once one of the greatest threats to Mondstadt is now one of our most reliable allies... Fate sure is an unpredictable force, huh? You never know which way the wind will blow next.

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Our Spark Knight is getting better and better at escaping the solitary confinement room, isn't she? Seems like she's been taking my "teachings" to heart. Maybe I could even learn a thing or two from her... Uh, I mean, uhh... Y'know, forget I said that! I was talking about, uh... painting techniques, yeah. *sigh* You're not gonna tell Jean or Albedo about this, are you? Um... Oh, please don't tell Alice, either. Thanks.

voices.title: About Alice
voices.text: Of all the titles Alice holds, the one I envy most is "Adventurer of Many Worlds." I traveled plenty in my youth, but when I hear her describe the things she's seen, most of it is beyond my ability to even imagine. I wonder if I'll get a chance to broaden my horizons after I step down as Grand Master... Though it's an open question if I'll still have the energy for it by then, haha!

voices.title: About Nicole
voices.text: There's a lot of things I'd like to learn from Nicole. With her incredible sense of direction, I'd never have to worry about getting lost on an expedition. And that telepathic communication ability would be really handy for sending covert messages across the battlefield... What's that? Waste of an angel's powers? Hey, they're very practical applications!

voices.title: About Barbeloth
voices.text: I once glimpsed a reflection of the future in Barbeloth's Scryglass. She said it was a vision that fate itself was trying to show me... But did fate also foresee that I would try to change it? And did it predict the way things would finally turn out?\nHmph... My answer is that there's no need to dwell on it. Overthinking things will only slow my sword. Whatever fate shows me, I'll still do whatever I believe is right.

voices.title: About Aino
voices.text: When I first met Aino, I was worried about her. Didn't seem right for such a young child to grow up on her own in Nod-Krai... Only later did I realize I had it all wrong. She's not alone, and she definitely doesn't need anyone to worry about her. Every child finds their own way to grow up, and worrying about them because of our preconceived ideas won't do them any good.

voices.title: About Ineffa
voices.text: When I asked her to deliver that letter to you, I had no idea about everything she'd been through. A soul born in captivity, who ultimately surmounted her curse and secured her freedom... I'm telling you, when her story reaches Mondstadt, it'll go down as one of the great epics! Whether it's Lady Vennessa or the Flower-Feather Clan, people are always inspired by tales of breaking free of your shackles in pursuit of freedom.

voices.title: About Flins
voices.text: People often confuse chivalry with the aristocratic code. Now, given how the aristocracy of Old Mondstadt conducted themselves, there was a time when I wouldn't have let ideas like that slide... But if all aristocrats were like Flins? Haha, I'd be happy to share a drink with them any day of the week!

voices.title: About Nefer
voices.text: The Northern Intelligence Network was a great help to our expeditionary force when we arrived in Nod-Krai. I intend to maintain our fruitful collaboration going forward — even thought of a codename for myself: "Lupus Majoris"! Huh? Pretty cool, right?

voices.title: About Jahoda
voices.text: She may gripe a lot, but once she gets to work, she's ruthlessly efficient. You know someone's got true grit when they can make a name for themselves as treasure hunter in a rough-and-tumble place like Nod-Krai! I've half a mind to recruit her to the Knights, but that would mean poaching her from her current boss, and... she probably wouldn't want to switch jobs anyway. Haha, I was even thinking of offering to double her pay, but it's probably better not to ask.

voices.title: About Mavuika
voices.text: Whether as a human or as a god, the Pyro Archon is a formidable warrior worthy of respect. If I'd been born in Natlan, I wonder if I'd have had the chance to cross blades with her while she was still human... Hmm, but then I wouldn't be able to protect Mondstadt, would I? No, that wouldn't do... *sigh* I suppose it's just as well.

voices.title: About The Captain
voices.text: I only met him once, but... Really? A knight of Khaenri'ah... "Sentinel Knight" Thrain, huh... Sounds like he took his destiny into his own hands.

voices.title: More About Varka: I
voices.text: Huh? Me? ...What do you mean, what're you curious about? ...Hold on, there's a book in the library called "100 Things You Never Knew About Varka"? Okay, now I'm curious too. I didn't even know that was a thing. Right, let's fact-check it.

voices.title: More About Varka: II
voices.text: "No Knight of Boreas has ever claimed to be the mightiest of all time, for both humility and honesty are knightly virtues — until Varka. Because when he claims this, he is being both humble and truthful." I uh... I don't know...

voices.title: More About Varka: III
voices.text: "The Four Winds of Mondstadt once referred to Varka's main sword, off-hand sword, left flying kick, and right fist. But nobody witnessed the full set and lived to tell the tale, so only the current version of the phrase remains." ...Well, that's going a bit far. No way could I handle all the work of The Four Winds alone.

voices.title: More About Varka: IV
voices.text: Maybe put that book away, it's a little ridiculous... Probably written by some drunk fool. As you can see, the real-life Varka is just a regular human like everyone else. I feel pain, I bleed, I age... So, just like any other friend, you'll learn more about me through a catch-up at the tavern than you will by listening to tall tales and rumors. What do you say, shall we grab a drink?

voices.title: More About Varka: V
voices.text: Drink up! Another round! Hahaha... Oh, where was I? Oh, yeah — this scar here is from scrapping with Boreas. That old wolf clawed me good! I almost howled louder than him... And this one's from when I solo'd the Hexenzirkel trials... If a mortal wants to protect everything, they have to be prepared to sacrifice everything. That's how I became the "Mightiest Knight of Boreas"... Yeah... That's how it happened...

voices.title: Varka's Hobbies
voices.text: I guess I used to be something of an adventurer myself. Heading for new horizons, facing new foes... it always gets you fired up, doesn't it? But nowadays... Well, there are more important things in life. Things that I need to protect.

voices.title: Varka's Troubles
voices.text: Let's see... Building our stronghold in Nod-Krai, allocating defense personnel for Dornman Port, organizing the return of the expeditionary forces, drawing up an itemized budget breakdown for the Knights of Favonius's expenses... Uggghhhhhhh... Why does it feel like the real torture begins after the expedition ends?

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Of course it's— Huh? You mean, other than alcohol... Wait, do wine-fermented sweet rice balls and chocolate liqueurs count? No? Uh... well... Hmm. I guess it'd have to be big slabs of meat seared over a high flame, some nice appetizers, cheese and nuts... hahaha...

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: There are some drinks out there that look alcoholic, smell alcoholic, but then you drink 'em... and there's not a drop of alcohol in there at all! That's gotta count as fraud, surely!?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Wow... What a masterpiece! This is the kind of food worth pairing with a bottle of the finest Dandelion Wine.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Now these are some good rations. The logistics team could stand to learn a thing or two from you.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Is this, uh... the kind of stuff you usually eat? Man. You adventurers have it just as rough as we do on our expeditions... Let's go get you some real food.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Happy Birthday! Don't go anywhere, the Knights of Favonius are getting ready to give you a birthday chorus. To be clear, this isn't an abuse of authority. They're the ones who suggested it! I just helped organize things and set up the venue. You do know how much we all adore our Honorary Knight, don't you? Now come on, everyone's waiting for the birthday star and lead singer!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: The first knightly virtue is "humility." Only by letting go of your ego and being willing to learn can you grow day by day.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: The second knightly virtue is "honesty." Deceitful and cunning words might win you the upper hand in the moment, but a victory won by the blade never lies.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: The third knightly virtue is "integrity." Every knight must live by their own conscience and walk their own path. Walk yours with steely resolve, and never waver.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: Remember the three knightly virtues? Good — now forget 'em all. Whatever kind of knight we wanna be, whatever path we choose to take, it's up to us!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: To the adventurer go the spoils. This loot's all yours.

voices.text: It's a knight's duty to defend his allies!

voices.text: Fall back, I'll take it from here.

voices.text: Boreas... can't end here...

voices.text: Huh... Turns out I can die...

voices.text: Alright, let's move out!

voices.text: Knight of Boreas, falling in.
